description: This file defines a custom exception class 'TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException' used in the Orleans storage system to indicate a failure due to ETag inconsistency during a storage update operation. It includes multiple constructors, serialization support, and properties for grain identification and table name.

classes.name: TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a failed storage update due to condition not being satisfied, specifically related to ETag mismatches in Azure Table Storage within Orleans.

methods.name: TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with detailed error message, grain info, table name, ETags, and inner exception.

methods.name: CreateDefaultMessage
methods.description: Static method to generate a default error message string based on grain type, ID, table name, stored ETag, and current ETag.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Overrides serialization method to include custom properties for serialization.
